newsitem.title: USA: California boy, 4, shoots, kills little brother.
newsitem.headline: California boy, 4, shoots, kills little brother.

text.p: A 4-year-old boy killed his 3-year-old brother with a gun his mother kept near her bed for protection, officials said on Sunday.
The accidental shooting took place on Saturday at a house in Rancho Cordova, near Sacramento, the Sacramento County Sheriff's Department said.

The 29-year-old mother slept in the bedroom of her two boys on Friday night because her husband was away on business, placing a handgun in the boys' night stand for protection, the department said in a statement.
The mother failed to remove the gun the next morning and the children got hold of it, the department said.
The mother was in the kitchen at about noon on Saturday when she heard a shot in the boys' bedroom.

She went there and found that her 3-year-old son had been shot in the side by his 4-year-old brother, the sheriff's department said. The boy was rushed to a local hospital, where he later died, it said.
The mother was taken to the sheriff's department for questioning and could face felony child-endangerment charges, the sheriff's department said. The 4-year-old was taken into protective custody.
